## project/.github/plugins/aidd-context/hooks/hooks.json
{
  "hooks": {
    "SessionStart": [
      {
        "hooks": [
          {
            "type": "command",
            "command": "node ${PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/memory.cjs load",
            "timeout": 5,
            "statusMessage": "AIDD Context: refresh project memory"
          },
          {
            "type": "command",
            "command": "node ${PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/artifacts.cjs start",
            "timeout": 5,
            "statusMessage": "AIDD Context: note turn start"
          }
        ]
      }
    ],
    "PostToolUse": [
      {
        "matcher": "Write|Edit|Bash|Shell|bash|PowerShell",
        "hooks": [
          {
            "type": "command",
            "command": "node ${PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/artifacts.cjs mark",
            "timeout": 5,
            "statusMessage": "AIDD Context: check written artifacts"
          }
        ]
      }
    ],
    "Stop": [
      {
        "hooks": [
          {
            "type": "command",
            "command": "node ${PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/memory.cjs sync",
            "timeout": 5,
            "statusMessage": "AIDD Context: sync project memory"
          }
        ]
      }
    ]
  }
}


## project/.github/plugins/aidd-context/hooks/lib/contracts/04-skill-generate/scripts/contract.json
{
  "version": 1,
  "kind": "skill",
  "unit": "folder",
  "targets": "plugins/*/skills/*",
  "scope": [".claude/skills/*", ".cursor/skills/*", ".opencode/skills/*", ".kilo/skills/*", ".github/skills/*", ".agents/skills/*"],
  "shell": false,
  "marker": "SKILL.md",
  "rules": {
    "SKILL-01": { "op": "max", "measure": "chars", "in": "SKILL.md", "field": "description", "max": 150,
      "why": "every description loads in every session", "fix": "cut the description to 150 characters, it has {actual}" },
    "SKILL-02": { "op": "forbidden", "in": "SKILL.md", "field": "description", "regex": ":",
      "why": "a colon breaks unquoted YAML on some hosts", "fix": "remove the colon from the description" },
    "SKILL-03": { "op": "forbidden", "in": "SKILL.md", "field": "description", "regex": "\\s[-–—]\\s",
      "why": "a dash splits the trigger into two claims", "fix": "remove the dash separator from the description" },
    "SKILL-04": { "op": "forbidden", "in": "SKILL.md", "field": "description", "regex": "[.!?]\\s+\\S",
      "why": "the model matches one trigger sentence", "fix": "make the description one sentence" },
    "SKILL-05": { "op": "sections", "in": "SKILL.md", "allowed": ["Transversal rules"],
      "why": "the router loads on every call; detail belongs in actions", "fix": "keep only the diagram and the transversal rules after the title" },
    "SKILL-06": { "op": "custom", "in": "SKILL.md", "check": "router-diagram",
      "why": "the diagram is the only route to an action" },
    "SKILL-07": { "op": "custom", "in": "SKILL.md", "check": "router-edges",
      "why": "an edge the model cannot follow is a dead route", "fix": "link the target action from the source step" },
    "SKILL-08": { "op": "pattern", "in": "actions/*.md", "line": 1, "regex": "^# \\d\\d - \\S",
      "why": "the number orders actions across hosts", "fix": "start with `# <NN> - <Title>`" },
    "SKILL-09": { "op": "sections", "in": "actions/*.md", "allowed": ["Input", "Process", "Output", "Rules"], "order": true,
      "why": "one shape lets the model find the steps", "fix": "use only and in order Input, Process, Output, Rules" },
    "SKILL-10": { "op": "custom", "in": "actions/*.md", "check": "read-next",
      "why": "a chained action that does not link the next stops the flow", "fix": "end with a step that reads the next action, as a link" },
    "SKILL-11": { "op": "oneSentence", "in": ["SKILL.md", "actions/*.md"], "sections": ["Process", "Rules", "Transversal rules"], "skipIndentedIn": ["Rules", "Transversal rules"],
      "why": "one instruction per item is followed, two are merged", "fix": "keep one sentence per item, or put exact text in backticks; in a step, cases go as dash sub-items" },
    "SKILL-12": { "op": "flatList", "in": ["SKILL.md", "actions/*.md"], "sections": ["Rules", "Transversal rules"],
      "why": "a nested rule hides its condition", "fix": "write the rule on one line, its case inside the sentence" },
    "SKILL-13": { "op": "max", "measure": "lines", "in": "{actions,references}/**/*.md", "max": 100,
      "why": "a long action dilutes the step being run", "fix": "split the file, it has {actual} lines" },
    "SKILL-14": { "op": "forbidden", "in": "**/*.md", "notIn": "assets/**", "scope": "nofence", "regex": "<!--[\\s\\S]*?--!?>",
      "why": "hosts strip or show comments inconsistently", "fix": "state it in the prose, or move it to an asset" },
    "SKILL-15": { "op": "forbidden", "in": "**/*.md", "notIn": "assets/**", "regex": "\\{\\{[^{}\\n]*\\}\\}",
      "why": "an unfilled slot is read as an instruction", "fix": "fill the template slot, or move it to an asset" },
    "SKILL-16": { "op": "forbidden", "in": "**/*.md", "regex": "\\*\\*",
      "why": "bold competes with the instruction order", "fix": "write the sentence without bold" },
    "SKILL-17": { "op": "links", "in": "**/*.md", "notIn": "assets/**",
      "why": "a dead link is a step the model cannot take", "fix": "fix the link, {target} does not exist" },
    "SKILL-18": { "op": "equals", "in": "SKILL.md", "field": "name", "to": "folder",
      "why": "hosts that validate skills require the name to be the folder's", "fix": "name the skill {expected}, as its folder" },
    "SKILL-20": { "op": "pattern", "in": "SKILL.md", "field": "description", "regex": "\\S",
      "why": "the description is the only way the model finds the skill", "fix": "give the skill a description in its front matter" },
    "SKILL-21": { "op": "links", "in": "**/*.md", "inside": true,
      "why": "a link leaving the skill is dead in every installed copy", "fix": "name the file in prose, {target} is outside the skill" },
    "SKILL-22": { "op": "custom", "in": ["SKILL.md", "actions/**/*.md", "references/**/*.md"], "check": "sibling-plugin",
      "why": "a plugin works without its siblings installed" }
  }
}

- {{requirement}}

## project/.github/plugins/aidd-context/hooks/lib/contracts/05-rule-generate/scripts/contract.json
{
  "version": 1,
  "kind": "rule",
  "unit": "file",
  "scope": ["aidd_docs/rules/*/*.md"],
  "rules": {
    "RULE-01": {
      "op": "template",
      "in": "*.md",
      "template": "../assets/rule-template.md",
      "optional": ["paths", "{{group}}"],
      "why": "every host copy is rendered from the source, so its shape must hold",
      "fix": "follow rule-template.md"
    }
  }
}


## project/.github/plugins/aidd-context/hooks/lib/contracts/06-agent-generate/scripts/contract.json
{
  "version": 1,
  "kind": "agent",
  "unit": "file",
  "targets": "plugins/*/agents/*.md",
  "scope": [
    ".claude/agents/*.md",
    ".cursor/agents/*.md"
  ],
  "shell": false,
  "rules": {
    "AGENT-02": {
      "op": "equals",
      "in": "*.md",
      "field": "name",
      "to": "basename",
      "why": "hosts resolve the agent by file name",
      "fix": "set name to {expected}"
    },
    "AGENT-03": {
      "op": "pattern",
      "in": "*.md",
      "field": "description",
      "regex": "\\. Use to ",
      "why": "A4: what it does, then when to call it",
      "fix": "end the description with `Use to <when>`"
    },
    "AGENT-04": {
      "op": "sections",
      "in": "*.md",
      "level": 1,
      "allowed": [
        "Role",
        "Behavior",
        "Output"
      ],
      "order": true,
      "required": [
        "Role",
        "Behavior",
        "Output"
      ],
      "why": "A5-A7: the caller reads role, boundary, then return format",
      "fix": "use exactly # Role, # Behavior, # Output in that order"
    },
    "AGENT-05": {
      "op": "forbidden",
      "in": "*.md",
      "regex": "\\{\\{[^{}\\n]*\\}\\}",
      "why": "an unfilled slot is read as an instruction",
      "fix": "fill the template slot"
    }
  }
}
